scope: Validation only. Rescores the saved 17 October TC2 pilot videos with the unchanged action scorers at the 0.5-second window and at the final frame. No sampling, training or test split.
motion_rule: unchanged scorers: moving needs displacement >= motion_threshold, correct signs need projections >= motion_threshold and drift is maximum excursion >= threshold
eligibility_rule: a horizon is scored only if no hidden-physics reference has a collision or wall onset before its end frame

corpus.source: TC2 copy collected on 17 October; every planned input is hash-checked after relocation

command: python -m click2future.evaluation.action_horizon --plan PLAN --predictions SAMPLES/predictions.json --output NEW.json --relocate TC2_PILOT=LOCAL --relocate TC2_OPERATIONS=LOCAL --relocate TC2_RELEASE=REPOSITORY
verification: Every window summary reproduces the recorded TC2 actions.json or targets.json. Five are byte-equal; flow-motion-validation differs only in forward.mean_direction_error_degrees at the 16th significant digit (1.9220297884259012 here, 1.922029788425901 on TC2), a cross-platform floating-point difference. All counts are identical.
regeneration_note: Regenerating the pilot corpus on macOS arm64 from seed 730000 reproduces all 24 checked validation arrays byte for byte, but 12/24 metadata files differ in the last digit of one geometry float, so the dataset manifest hash differs (dcdd0e0c, not 03c9468e). Checkpoints trained on TC2 then refuse that copy. Use the collected TC2 corpus for checkpoint evaluation.
detailed_reports: Per-sample reports stay in the local outputs/horizon-20261025 folder; they are not committed.
limitations: One training seed per model and four validation scene groups.
Full-horizon selected-object scores rest on 2 of 4 groups; the other two reach contact before the final frame.
E0 RGB, E2, E3 and E4 have no complete tracks at either horizon, so their action scores stay undefined.
